extDescription.message: Say how you feel: music, a soundscape generated on the spot and comforting media. No account, and everything stays on your computer.

moodLabel.message: How are you feeling, right now?

moodPlaceholder.message: a few honest words about today…

moodImageInstruction.message: Or would you rather show it with a picture?

moodImageHint.message: It never leaves this computer — promise.

moodImageDropAria.message: Choose a picture that says how you feel, or drag it here

moodImageFeelingPlaceholder.message: this is what your picture tells me — fix me where I'm wrong

moodImagePrivacy.message: It never leaves this computer — promise.

moodImageAnalyzing.message: Give me a moment, I'm looking…

moodImageError.message: Hmm, that one won't open. Want to try another?

moodChipGroup.message: Shortcuts, for when words are hard

sessionTipsHeading.message: A few things for this session

libraryUnavailable.message: The library's being quiet. I'll try again in a bit.

spotifySyncOk.message: Library's fresh: $COUNT$ tracks waiting for you.

spotifySyncError.message: Couldn't refresh just now ($DETAIL$) — I'll try later.

spotifyLibraryEmpty.message: Nothing in the library yet — check back soon.

musicGeoHint.message: Only songs from that place. The menus follow real places in the catalogue — stop anywhere, that level counts. No country on a song? You'll only meet it under «Everywhere».

musicGeoEmpty.message: No songs from here in the collection — try widening the map a little.

therapyGeoEmpty.message: No $MEDIUM$ from here in the collection.

therapyEmpty.message: Nothing to offer right now — that's okay too.

playlistEmpty.message: No playlist yet — tell me how you are and we'll make one.

musicLangStatusIt.message: Got it: more content in Italian

musicLangStatusEn.message: Got it: more content in English

providerHintB2B.message: This service has no public player, so I'll open a web search for the track.

providerNoteItunes.message: The iTunes catalog lives on Apple Music web these days — I'll open it there.

providerNoteKuack.message: A business platform with no public player: I'll open a web search for the track.

providerNoteAdaptr.message: A developer service with no public player: I'll open a web search for the track.

providerNoteMedianet.message: A licensing service with no public player: I'll open a web search for the track.

vjLandscapeHint.message: Vision is a slow window: calm landscapes at three frames per second. Its images stay below the WCAG flash thresholds; the YouTube video underneath is not controlled by Auscultrix.

btnMoreResultsHint.message: Same mood, a new alternative session

btnMoreMediaHint.message: Fresh results for every medium: music, books, films, series and games

donationPipBody.message: Auscultrix is free, and everything stays on your computer. If it helped you lately, a coffee keeps it going.

nowPlayingMuted.message: $TITLE$ · starting muted — tap the video for sound

nowPlayingBlocked.message: $TITLE$ · sound blocked by the browser — open the tab and tap play

ffAudioBanner.message: Muted sound on Firefox? In the YouTube tab, tap the padlock in the address bar → Autoplay → Allow audio and video.

disclaimer.message: Auscultrix is a digital-arts work that keeps you company with comforting media — music, books, films, calm landscapes. It is not a medical device and does not replace care. If you're struggling, please talk to someone you trust — your doctor, a psychologist, a friend. What you write stays on your computer.

supportHeading.message: If you need someone to talk to

errorTrackMissing.message: I can't find that track — let's pick another.

errorPlaylistEmpty.message: The playlist is empty — start with how you feel.

errorAutoAdvanceCooldown.message: Give it a moment between tracks

errorNextTrackMissing.message: The next track got lost — try pressing Next again.

errorWrongPlayerTab.message: That's not the tab playing our music.

tip_breath_body.message: Three slow breaths before the first track. Nothing more.

tip_posture_body.message: Soft shoulders, gentle volume. The music comes to you.

tip_length_body.message: Fifteen, thirty minutes. A few tracks truly heard beat an endless playlist.

tip_hydrate_body.message: Keep a glass nearby. A sip between tracks.

tip_pause_body.message: If tension rises, switch off. Silence is part of listening too.

tip_journal_body.message: Afterwards, write down how it went. One line is plenty.

tip_calm_pace_body.message: Low volume. Let the track end on its own.

tip_gentle_presence_body.message: You don't have to sort anything out. Stay with what's there, one track at a time.

tip_gentle_lift_body.message: Start with something you know. If it runs too fast, slow down.

tip_sustain_body.message: Every two or three tracks: a pause, a sip of water, then on you go.

tip_soft_focus_body.message: If your mind wanders, come back to the breath. Happens to everyone.

tip_focus_window_body.message: Notifications off, one listen. Nothing else to do.

tip_low_energy_body.message: On days like this, one whole track is already a lot.

tip_balanced_body.message: Not too high, not too low — whatever you can carry today.

tip_session_great_pace_body.message: The energy is there, no need to rush. Keep it light.

tip_session_great_focus_body.message: Listen without speeding up. If it climbs too fast, one step back.

tip_session_sad_pace_body.message: Go slowly. Silence is fine. One track at a time.

tip_session_sad_focus_body.message: There's nothing to sort out. Stay close to what you feel.

tip_session_anxious_pace_body.message: Start with tracks you know. If tension rises, feel free to stop.

tip_session_anxious_focus_body.message: Low volume. When the mind races, the breath is right there.

tip_session_tired_pace_body.message: A little is enough. One whole track is already plenty.

tip_session_tired_focus_body.message: Resting is part of the session too.

tip_session_motivated_pace_body.message: Energy likes company, not pressure. Every two tracks, a pause.

tip_session_motivated_focus_body.message: Stay within what you can carry. That's already good.

tip_session_relaxed_pace_body.message: Nothing to prove today. Enjoy the ease.

tip_session_relaxed_focus_body.message: Follow the rhythm of your breath. That's all there is to do.

tip_session_balanced_pace_body.message: Start with something you know. If it speeds up too much, come back down.

tip_session_balanced_focus_body.message: If the mind wanders, the breath is always there.

insight_motivation_low.message: Not much drive today — that's okay. We'll start slow and climb gently.

insight_motivation_high.message: You've got good energy today — let's keep it glowing, gently.

insight_motivation_mid.message: You're halfway there: tracks to keep you steady and lift you slowly.

insight_direction_low.message: I'll start with songs close to how you feel, then climb toward something brighter.

insight_direction_high.message: Full tracks, to ride the energy you already have.

insight_direction_mid.message: A quiet mix — not too high, not too low.

insight_rehab_anxious.message: I can hear tension in your words: we'll start there, and let it loosen bit by bit.

insight_rehab_sad.message: Today feels heavy. Music won't fix it, but it can keep you company while it passes.

insight_rehab_neutral.message: An ordinary day. A good listen might add a little colour.

chooseForMeHint.message: First tell me how you are

chooseChoseBook.message: How about a book — $TITLE$? Opening it for you.

chooseChoseFilm.message: How about a film — $TITLE$? Opening it where you can watch.

ttsNoLocalVoice.message: There is no voice installed on this device for this language. So that the text is not sent to an online service, reading aloud stays off.

therapyMediaNote.message: Chosen for their tone: close to how you feel, then a step calmer. Every title has been reviewed: no suicide or self-harm, violence, abuse or addiction. They are company, not a cure.

yourDataBody.message: What you write and your photo stay on this computer: I don't send them anywhere. Below you can see what I remember, and you can wipe it all whenever you like.

chooseChoseSeries.message: How about the series $TITLE$? Opening where you can watch.

chooseChoseOther.message: This one caught my eye: $TITLE$. Opening it now.

safetyCrisisTitle.message: You are not alone right now.

safetyCrisisBody.message: What you wrote matters. Talking to a real person now can help, and you can stay anonymous. The music is still here whenever you want it.

safetySubstanceBody.message: Substances promise relief and then take it back. If you want to talk to someone, there is a free, anonymous national line in Italy. Meanwhile, here is something that comforts without taking anything away.

safetyAddictionLabel.message: Addiction line — ISS (Italy), Monday to Friday

safetyInsightCrisis.message: Right now what matters most is you, not the music.

safetyInsightCrisisNext.message: If you can, call one of the numbers above or message someone you trust. The playlist is ready and starts only if you ask.

chooseCrisisHold.message: I won't open anything on my own right now. The numbers above first; the media stay below whenever you want them.

careKidsNotice.message: For young listeners I only suggest suitable music. Books, films and games are better chosen together with an adult.

playlistFinished.message: That's the end of this session. If you like, «Another little magic» makes a new one.

playerDetached.message: Paused: you are watching another video on YouTube, so Auscultrix steps aside and lets YouTube carry on.

playlistNotCalibrated.message: For this choice I have no tracks with documented emotional coordinates: this is a discovery list, not a path calibrated on your mood.

playlistCalibratedAll.message: Every track has documented emotional coordinates, annotated from the literature or measured on the audio.

playlistCalibrationNote.message: $CAL$ of $TOT$ tracks have documented emotional coordinates. The others are discoveries, marked as such, and only come after the first 25 minutes.

trackDiscoveryHint.message: Emotional coordinates not documented: not chosen for your mood.

lyricsToggleHint.message: If you turn it on, title and artist of the suggested tracks go to lrclib.net to read their lyrics. Only numbers stay here.

yourDataFlows.message: What leaves this computer: nothing you write. YouTube receives the track you open; Spotify and Bandcamp only get requests to refresh the public catalogues.

onboardStep1.message: Write a few words about how you feel, or tap a label.

onboardStep2.message: Press «Begin»: music starts on YouTube close to how you feel, then moves gently.

onboardStep3.message: Stop whenever you like. At the bottom of the panel you'll always find people who can help.

optionsIntro.message: Catalogues refresh by themselves and what you write stays on this computer. Choices about your data are in the panel, under «Your things».

optionsSafety.message: Auscultrix is not a medical device. If you're struggling, call 112 (EU) or Telefono Amico in Italy (02 2327 2327).

soundscapeLede.message: A composition generated here, on your computer: it starts from how you feel and moves slowly. No network, no one else's tracks.

soundscapeDefaultLabel.message: «Start» plays the soundscape instead of YouTube

soundscapeExportBody.message: Same state, same seed, same composition: archive it, analyse it or rebuild it in Pure Data. The files hold numbers only, never what you wrote.

soundscapeExported.message: Done: the file is in your downloads.

soundscapeEnded.message: The end. Silence is part of the soundscape too.

soundscapeCrisisHold.message: Help comes first: the soundscape starts only when you ask for it.

soundscapeMapDesc.message: It starts at mood $P1$ % and energy $P2$ % and moves toward mood $P3$ % and energy $P4$ %. The filled dot is where it is now.

diaryMapTitle.message: Your sessions on the mood–energy plane

diaryMapDesc.message: Sessions: $P1$. On average mood $P2$ % and energy $P3$ %. Each arrow goes from how you felt to the point the session moved toward.

diaryMapCaption.message: Sessions remembered: $P1$. Each arrow goes from how you felt to where the session was taking you. Average: mood $P2$ %, energy $P3$ %; mean shift $P4$ %. These are your words turned into numbers, not a measure of health.

diaryMapEmpty.message: The map is drawn after your first session.

resumeBarText.message: You are watching another video: the session is waiting. Whenever you like, it restarts from here and carries on by itself.
